_note: Version 85 soundtrack, made with PixelLab create_music then make_music_loop. Each: bpm asked, style prompt, the takes' song ids, the loop take used (song id where logged, and its file path). Exclude list for all: vocals, singing, fade out, orchestra, pads, guitar solo. Length asked: 70 s.
